title: Divergence of Fate
next_chapter_hook: At the very moment when the two threads of fate gradually became clear, Chen Ji felt a sharp pain in his chest—the power of the Heavenly Fate Key was frantically interfering with the Tianji Record's foresight, dragging him into a vortex of chaos.

text.content: That gaze that pierced through all boundaries struck like ten thousand arrows through his heart, Chen Ji's spine instantly rigid. He didn't turn around, but every hair on his body stood on end—this was the instinct he had developed through years of cultivation, that suffocating feeling of being locked onto when a predator's gaze fell upon its prey. Ling Yuan's gaze carried no killing intent, yet it was more terrifying than killing intent, because within it were夹杂着scrutinizing、amused，还有一丝说不清道不明的......expectant。

Chen Ji turned around slowly, his face wearing its usual mask of timidity and fear. His gaze collided with Ling Yuan's in mid-air, and in that instant, he clearly saw the corner of the old sect master's mouth curve upward slightly—it wasn't relief, but rather the pleasure of a hunter watching prey walk into a trap. 'Senior Ancestor...' Chen Ji's voice trembled slightly, his bowing posture flawless, 'Your disciple was merely deterring those disrespectful trash just now, disturbing the Senior Ancestor, I humbly beg for forgiveness.'

Ling Yuan's voice was aged and calm, revealing no emotion. But the moment Chen Ji raised his head, the fragment on his chest suddenly trembled—the Tianji Record self-activated! Golden runes flickered beneath his robes, as if sensing the approach of some deadly crisis. Chen Ji was greatly startled, but dared not show any abnormality on his face, merely lowering his head in silence. Yet the fragment trembled more and more violently, a majestic stream of information forcibly pouring into his consciousness.

Two distinctly different scenes unfolded before his eyes, like a book of destiny revealing two heavy pages. On the left, a morning dawn breaking, a white-robed figure standing proudly atop a mountain peak, robes billowing in the wind—this was Su Qingyao. She turned to look back, her gaze containing scrutiny, warning, but also a trace of... expectation that he himself had not noticed. Below the image appeared golden text: 'The Righteous Path, the cost—sacrifice three years of lifespan, in exchange for qualification to enter the secret realm.'

The right side presented a starkly different scene. A dark underground altar burned with eerie purple flames, with a familiar figure standing at its center—Chen Nian! His sister, bound in chains, eyes devoid of spirit, only a strange smile hanging at the corner of her mouth, as if waiting for something. Below the image also appeared golden text: 'The Forbidden Path, the cost—sacrifice 80 Heavenly Fate points, to unlock the sealed truth.' Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply, his heart seemingly gripped tightly by an invisible hand.

Two paths, two costs, both pointing to the same destination—the ancient secret realm said to contain all the secrets of the 'Father of the Tianji Record.' Chen Ji suddenly remembered his father's last words before disappearing: 'Ji'er, remember, some truths are better left unknown.' At that time he didn't understand, now he does—these two paths, whichever one he chooses, could drag him into an abyss from which there is no return.

A clear, cold voice sounded behind him. Chen Ji turned to see Su Qingyao had somehow already stood three zhang away. She wore the standard Taoist robe of an Inner Disciple Senior Fellow, frost in her brows and eyes, a translucent jade pendant hanging from her waist—the identity symbol of a Tianqing Sect lineage disciple. 'That sword just now...' Su Qingyao's gaze swept over him, her tone carrying a hint of inquiry, 'You've attracted too much attention.' Her gaze unconsciously swept toward the distance, where Ling Yuan's figure had already vanished.

dialogue.content: Follow me, there are some things unsuitable to discuss here.

text.content: The moment these words fell, the fragment on Chen Ji's chest trembled violently again. Another figure appeared in his consciousness—Chen Nian's blurry outline, standing on a path he had never foreseen, reaching out to him. That path had no name, no cost marked, only a heart-stopping expanse of chaos. And in the moment he froze, a hoarse, familiar voice rang in his ear: 'Boy, the key to fate has awakened, are you sure you want to keep looking?' That was Mo Xiansheng's warning.

Two paths, two women, two entirely different trajectories of fate. Chen Ji stood in place, his heart churning like a turbulent sea. Su Qingyao represented the righteous path, legitimate sect inheritance, a path of rising through proper means; while the forbidden path where Chen Nian was located, though filled with unknown dangers, led directly to the truth he had been desperately seeking—his father's disappearance, his sister's whereabouts, the complete form of the Tianji Record... Yet Mo Xiansheng's words were like a bucket of cold water poured over his head, making him suddenly realize a terrifying possibility: could these two paths both be traps set by others?

text.content: Chen Ji abruptly closed his eyes. When he opened them again, his pupils reflected two entirely different visions—the figures of Su Qingyao and Chen Nian had actually overlapped at this moment!

Chen Ji stood in place, his gaze drifting between Su Qingyao and that illusory phantom. He suddenly noticed a detail overlooked by everyone—Su Qingyao and Chen Nian were actually seventy percent similar! The same willow-leaf eyebrows, the same phoenix eyes, the same jawline arc... The moment this thought emerged, it sent chills down his spine. He had never noticed this, or rather, someone had deliberately made him ignore this.

At this moment, a flash of spiritual light burst forth in his mind. The reason the Tianji Record's prophecy showed two diverging paths was not because of fate's choice, but because Chen Nian's 'Heavenly Fate Key' constitution was interfering with his foresight! Any foresight involving her was blurry—this meant the 'Forbidden Path' he saw might not be the real forbidden path at all, but a phantom distorted by the key's power!

Mo Xiansheng's aged voice rang in his mind, carrying a rare note of approval. 'The function of the Heavenly Fate Key was never to 'lock' fate, but to 'disrupt' people's destiny. Chen Nian's presence let you see two paths; but precisely because of her presence, both paths may not be real. The true path lies within the chaos.' Chen Ji's body trembled, a bold idea sprouting in his heart—if he could forcibly activate the full potential of the Tianji Record while Chen Nian interfered with the foresight...

At this moment, a tremendous roar suddenly echoed from the distance. The sky instantly darkened, and a massive black shadow was pressing down from the horizon—that was Ling Yuan's aura, approaching at an inconceivable speed! 'Good grandson,' the old sect master's voice pierced through the void, carrying undeniable authority, 'I have waited for this choice of yours for a full twenty years.' Chen Ji's pupils contracted violently—twenty years ago was precisely the year his father disappeared.

The two paths instantly lost their luster, replaced by a chaotic vortex. Chen Ji felt a sharp pain in his chest—that was the Tianji Record fragment frantically warning—the Heavenly Fate Key's power was fully awakening, dragging him into an unprecedented fog. He faintly saw, at the deepest part of that fog, a familiar figure walking toward him—it was... Chen Nian? No, it was another Chen Nian, one who should not exist in this world. Her lips moved, silently uttering four words: 'Father... is still alive.'

Chen Ji's heart nearly stopped beating. Father... is still alive? This thought was like thunder exploding in his mind, making him momentarily unable to distinguish whether this was the Tianji Record's prophecy or a hallucination created by the Heavenly Fate Key. But one thing he could be certain of—Ling Yuan was approaching, and this scheming power-holder seemed to know all the answers. 'Interesting,' Chen Ji murmured, a meaningful arc curving at the corner of his mouth, 'It seems today, not only must I answer multiple choice questions, but also settle some old scores.' In his eyes, cowardice and timidity faded away, replaced by an abyssal cold light.
